desc: Check if the given network exists
r: podman-network-exists - Check if the given network exists

podman network exists checks if a network exists. The Name or ID of the network may be used as input. Podman returns an exit code of 0 when the network is found. A 1 is returned otherwise. An exit code of 125 indicates there was another issue.

Check if specified network exists (the network does actually exist):

$ podman network exists net1
$ echo $?
0

Check if nonexistent network exists:

$ podman network exists webbackend
$ echo $?
1
